rows.name: question_block_2x2 tile table (? block 16x16 quadrants)
rows.notes: PRG source of the four 8x8 tile ids that make up the 16x16 ? block. On a World 1-1 ? block the nametable shows TL=$53, TR=$54, BL=$55, BR=$56. Proof: ledgered write_memory prgRom 0xC8C, byte $53 -> $24 (sky blank), reason "prove 0xC8C is the ? block tile table", ledger seq 1; reset_emulator; pressed Start twice to begin 1-1 and held Right 150 frames. Screenshot sha 549378d6 showed every on-screen ? block missing its top-left quarter, and get_tile_at_pixel read the four quadrants as TL=$24 (36), TR=$54 (84), BL=$55 (85), BR=$56 (86) - only the edited byte changed. undo_edit restored $53. Found by search_memory prgRom for 53 55 54 56 after reading the block's tile ids with get_tile_at_pixel.

rows.name: small Mario standing-frame tile table
rows.notes: PRG source of the tile ids that make small Mario's standing frame. Small Mario on screen is a 2x2 sprite: list_sprites showed OAM tiles 58/55/79/79 ($3A/$37/$4F/$4F), palette 4, at screen (40..55, 194..209), with $FC padding rows in a 2x4 handler slot. Proof: ledgered write_memory prgRom 0x6ED3, byte $3A -> $FC (blank), reason "prove 0x6ED3 is the standing-frame tile table", ledger seq 1; reset_emulator. Immediately after the reset list_sprites already showed OAM index 5 at (40,193) changed from tile 58 to tile 252 ($FC) while 55/79/79 were unchanged; starting 1-1, the screenshot (sha e17a8a2c) showed part of Mario's head missing, (44,196) rendered hill green $1A where the $3A half used to draw, while (52,196) still rendered skin $27 from the $37 half. undo_edit restored $3A. Found by search_memory prgRom for 3A 37 4F 4F after reading the standing OAM with list_sprites.
